ModMetaData.name: Auto-Cut Blight (rimhunter)
ModMetaData.author: rimhunter (written from scratch; the idea is from the original Auto-Cut Blight)
ModMetaData.description:
Auto-Cut Blight (rimhunter) is written from scratch by rimhunter for RimWorld 1.6 and 1.7. The idea is from the original Auto-Cut Blight; no code or asset of the original was used. Source and changelog: https://github.com/rimhunter/auto-cut-blight
Do not run another Auto-Cut Blight alongside this one: RimWorld's mod list should warn when one of the original builds is enabled (tested with stand-in mods; the original builds were never run).
